verdict.rationale: First-party materials show Fin running natively in Intercom and inside existing helpdesks. There are dedicated Zendesk and Salesforce integration articles, plus 'Your team stays on Salesforce/Freshdesk/HubSpot' pages and a claim that Fin 'works seamlessly with any helpdesk'. A standalone Fin Agent API covers the standalone mode, and hand-off to the preferred inbox, external-system updates and webhooks suggest context flows back. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bidirectional ticket/context sync mechanics (the helpdesk articles are titles only), the standalone orchestration endpoints being Preview-only, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
